name: Startups.com

sources.title: Help — profile visibility settings (Public/Private/Hidden) and the unique public profile URL live under Manage Account > Personal Profile
Registration page (search-indexed) — name, email or phone, password
Homepage (search-indexed) — online startup accelerator; 'Requests' roadmap, investor matching, community forums; returned HTTP 429 to direct fetch

conditions: Account creation and a startup profile are free, but the startup profile's public discoverability depends on the Profile Visibility setting (Public/Private/Hidden)

This is an accelerator/founder community — the value is the program (advisors, courses, investor matching), and much of that is paid membership; the public profile is a side artifact, not a launch listing
requirements: Register at startups.com/signup/register (name + email or phone + password, or Google on the accelerator form)
Startup profile data: company name, industry, team size, funding stage, logo
Set Profile Visibility to Public for an externally viewable profile URL
preparation: Founder name, email, password (or phone signup)
Startup details: name, industry, stage, logo
Expect onboarding into the accelerator funnel (Requests/roadmap prompts)
workflow: Register at https://www.startups.com/signup/register (site rate-limited automated fetches — use a browser)
Complete the startup profile under /account/startup (name, industry, team size, funding stage, logo)
Set Personal Profile visibility to Public and copy the unique profile URL
Optionally explore the community, Requests roadmap, investor matching and workshops (membership tiers apply)
watchFor: 429 rate-limiting observed on direct fetches — use a browser
Not a public launch directory — a 'Public' profile URL exists but there is no browsable public launch feed guarantee
Accelerator upsell: advisor calls, courses, investor matching are the paid product
Same family as Fundable, Clarity.fm, Bizplan, Launchrock — expect cross-product marketing
countsAsLive: The personal/startup profile resolves at its unique startups.com URL with visibility set to Public
unknowns: Whether public profiles are indexable or render a website link (and follow treatment)
Free-tier limits on the accelerator/community features
Whether startup profiles have a public directory page
